response.query: What enrollment quotas and outreach strategies will ensure equitable representation, and what contingency recruitment actions will trigger if targets are missed?
response.answer: Enrollment quotas aim for diverse representation; if targets are missed, contingency recruitment focuses on additional outreach and partnerships.

results.content: Unless otherwise expressly stated, the financial information of our company included in this prospectus reflects the historical financial statements of Smithfield (which has been an indirect, wholly owned subsidiary of WH Group), as retroactively adjusted to remove the impact of the discontinued operations. Smithfield is an American food company and an industry leader in value-added packaged meats and fresh pork with over $14 billion in annual sales. For additional information regarding Ratio of Net Debt to Adjusted EBITDA, including a reconciliation to ratio of debt to net income, the most directly comparable GAAP measure, see “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of our Financial Condition and Results of Operations – Non-GAAP Measures.”. Approximately one-third of our fresh pork products, including the majority of hams, bellies and trimmings, is transferred to our Packaged Meats segment, providing it with approximately 80% of its raw material requirements for the nine months ended September 29, 2024.
